scope: Explicit legacy API Dataset/result separation, exact publication bindings and explicit wrapper mapping selection; synthetic fixture and existing regression tests

depends_on.status_at_evidence_capture: open; required publication gate included in this tested tree

coordinator_console_summary.basis: Coordinator terminal summary; warning count is not encoded in this JUnit file

limitations: This suite verifies the software API/publication contract using synthetic mapped records and existing regressions; it does not validate scientific mapping meaning or source coverage.
The dataset_v1 contract is explicit. Default legacy no-output shapes remain unchanged; default legacy file publication with embedded transformation_metadata still refuses closed-Dataset validation.

The unchanged default legacy TSV omits required Dataset.id. Successful tests explicitly select compatible small mappings; no default mapping repair, invented ID or automatic mapper switch is supplied.
No-output dataset_v1 results remain unaccepted drafts with publication=null. preserve_provenance=False leaves transformation metadata absent, even for successful file publication.
Publication bindings identify exact written bytes at return time, including UTF-16 cases; they do not authenticate the algorithm or guarantee later unchanged files.
Mapping pins are local before/after byte checks, not atomic source snapshots or protection against changes that restore the same bytes.
The reused PR #4634 gate validates all batch candidates and stages all outputs before individual atomic replacements; no rollback across already-replaced files is promised.
Negative controls inject diagnostic, I/O and mapping-drift failures; these are regression controls, not measured production failure rates.
No current-cohort regeneration, real-project comparison publication, provider evaluation, paid attempt or scientific score was produced by this validation.
The PR depends on required-publication-gate PR #4634; only issues #4630 and #4635 are addressed by this result-contract slice. Parents #4594 and #2915 remain open.
Human scientific review, paid-run authorization, audit28 and held figure-branch decisions are unchanged; moving metadata or retiring rows is not improved source coverage.
